room_rent.note: If room taken exceeds limit, all associated expenses (except medicines, implants, diagnostics) are paid proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; Modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.): up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24mo: cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, hysterectomy etc.; 36mo: joint replacement, osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Code-Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 5% per claim-free year up to 50% of SI; alternatively policyholder may opt for 2.5% premium discount per year up to 25%

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.display: Covered for epidemic/pandemic only (up to 10% SI or ₹30,000)
domiciliary.note: Home Care Treatment limited to epidemic/pandemic cases, max 14 days per incident; general domiciliary hospitalisation is excluded

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered when hospitalised in recognised AYUSH hospital

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; air ambulance not mentioned

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, nebuliser kit, masks etc.) explicitly listed as non-payable in List I

global_cover.note: Policy restricted to treatment within India only (Clause 11.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly installments

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions: Maternity, domiciliary (non-epidemic), OPD, overseas treatment, sterility/IVF, consumables, refractive error <7.5D, war, nuclear/bio/chemical
